# teamcity_template (Resource)

A build configuration template is a set of reusable build configuration settings that other build configurations can inherit. More info [here](https://www.jetbrains.com/help/teamcity/build-configuration-template.html)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teamcity_project" "test" {
  name = "Test Project"
}

resource "teamcity_template" "test" {
  name        = "Test Template"
  project_id  = teamcity_project.test.id
  description = "My build configuration template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project where the build configuration template will be created.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the build configuration template. If not provided, it will be generated from the name.
